messages.text: Namaste. I'm NyayaSetu. Tell me what happened in your own words — what you bought, from where, what went wrong, and what you have done so far. I'll then ask only the questions that matter for your case, one at a time. You can skip any question.

I bought a front-load washing machine for ₹25,000 from HomeKart. It was delivered on 2 October 2026. Within 10 days the drum stopped spinning and it shows error code E21. The seller refuses to replace it and says I should contact the brand service centre.

Here is what I understood so far:
• Problem: Defective product / stopped working
• Product: front-load washing machine
• Amount paid: ₹25,000
• Delivery date: 2 October 2026

I'll ask a few short questions — you can skip any of them.

Which website or app did you buy it from? If you know the seller's name (it is on the invoice or order page), please add it — e.g. “ShopNest, seller: Gupta Electronics”.
HomeKart, seller: CoolHome Appliances

Noted: HomeKart, seller: CoolHome Appliances.

What is the Order ID? It is on the order page or the confirmation email.

Noted: HK-99812-AB.

On what date did you place the order (or pay)? An approximate date is fine.
28 September 2026

Noted: 28 September 2026.

Have you already complained to the seller or the platform? If yes: when, how (app, email, call, chat), and what did they say? Reply “no” if you have not complained yet.

Yes. I raised a replacement request in the HomeKart app on 13 October 2026. A technician from the brand visited on 15 October and gave a job sheet saying the motor is faulty. On 18 October the seller rejected the replacement request.

Noted.

Do you have a ticket or complaint reference number? Please type it (or skip).
Ticket HKT-30211

Noted: HKT-30211.

Which of these records do you have? Select all that apply — and keep the originals safe.

meta.question: evidence
options: Chat transcripts / messages with customer care

messages.text: Invoice / bill, Warranty card / warranty terms, Technician / service-centre report (job sheet), Photographs of the product / damage

Noted.

What outcome do you want — refund, replacement, repair, or something else?
Replacement with a new machine

Noted: Replacement.

Did you buy this for personal or household use, or for resale / business? (This affects whether consumer law applies.)
Personal / household use

Noted.

Last question: what name and city/district should appear on your complaint? (For example: “Priya Sharma, Pune”.) Please do NOT share Aadhaar, PAN, card numbers, bank passwords or OTPs — they are not needed.
Anil Kumar, Jaipur

Noted.

Thank you — I have enough to prepare your case file. Any details still missing will be clearly marked so you can add them later.
